progression.narrative: The performance opens on A#4 and dwells most on B in Nahib. The line peaks at C#5 (563.7 Hz) at 0:07.8. It closes on F#4, not the tonic (A#4 → A#4 → G#4 → G#4 → A4 → F#4).
